theme: Open calendar, pre-Croatia bookings, girls in St Pete
greeting: The calendar is clear today, but the pre-Croatia to-do list is doing the talking. A passport morning for the four girls, and a cluster of trip bookings still open before the Sept 8 departure.

needsAttention.title: Nautilus charter balance still open
needsAttention.detail: QuickBooks lists invoice 2170 to Nautilus Sailing as unpaid — worth closing out before the Sept 12 charter.

needsAttention.title: Sept 19 Cavtat night unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The last night after the charter, near Dubrovnik airport, still needs a room. Connectivity aboard is thin, so it has to be set from land before Sept 8.

needsAttention.title: St Pete landing gap unbooked
needsAttention.detail: Sept 20-22, the two nights between the Croatia return and the Orlando villa, still need somewhere to stay.

needsAttention.title: Checked bags not confirmed on the ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket reads zero checked bags — confirming the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site before Sept 8 keeps two 55L duffels from becoming an airport-counter problem.

needsAttention.title: Disney tickets for six not bought
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 26-27 Orlando weekend has rooms covered by the villa, but the six park tickets are the piece with the hard wall now.

schedule.title: Passport appointments, four girls
schedule.detail: Gateway Mall PO, new books for all four

flagged.title: AMEX balance alert
flagged.detail: myFICO flagged a rise in the reported balance on your AMEX card — informational.

flagged.title: Nanny applicants on Care.com
flagged.detail: Several sitters applied and one is nudging for a reply through Care.com.

inbox.noise: The rest is receipts and promos — Square, Hulu, Expedia, Google Play, a LinkedIn accept, and a utility bill.

recipe.title: Squid with Chili and Clams
recipe.why: High summer is peak season for briny shellfish that want little more than heat, chili, and a squeeze of lemon.

tasks.title: Buy EU adapters and a power strip for Croatia
Call dermatologist to book wart removal
Book refundable backup car, Sept 20 - Oct 5

acts.line: A 9:30 passport appointment for the girls sets the morning, with a run of phone calls to make around it.
No meetings on the calendar, so the open hours belong to the Croatia bookings that keep stacking up.
A calm stretch at the Kenwood place with the four girls before September's travel wave begins.
